source_instruction: i'm looking for a 32 ounce package of gluten free almond flour.
query: Ugh, my neighbor’s cat keeps sneaking onto my back porch to knock over the potted mint I’ve been growing for iced tea, and yesterday it chewed through half the string lights I strung up for the small weekend cookout I’m planning, plus I still haven’t figured out if I should bring a folding chair or just sit on the old picnic table out there. I’ve heard gluten free 32 ounce pantry staples under $30 are really easy to work with for people who have to watch what they eat for their weekly meal prep.
